entries.title: The project command failed its expected result
resolutionSteps: Read the command receipt's return code, stdout, and stderr.
Run the declared command in the bound workspace to reproduce the failure.
Fix the demonstrated cause and run a fresh probe against the final candidate.

entries.title: Required execution evidence is unavailable
resolutionSteps: Read the profile, target manifests, and receipt observation for the missing binding.
Bind the actual selected workspace, runtime, or application flow and rerun the probe.

entries.title: The selected application reported a runtime error
resolutionSteps: Inspect the fault rule and bounded evidence for the selected project.
Run the affected application probes again after repairing the cause.
